sources.title: Replication and conflict model
sources.version_or_commit: Stable 3.5 docs; no patch commit bound
sources.locator: Replication directions, conflicts, winner, 409 behavior, application resolution
sources.observed_operation: Independently reopened/read for this critic review.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Unidirectional replication; concurrent branches can coexist; ordinary reads expose deterministic winner; apps must inspect/resolve; same-node stale _rev may return 409.
sources.applicability: Supports P04, P07-P08; replication does not decide domain state.

sources.observed_operation: Independently reopened/read for this critic review.

sources.observed_operation: Independently reopened/read for this critic review.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Storage may be evicted under pressure; persist() asks for persistence but explicit user action can still clear it; Chromium-specific and dated page.
sources.applicability: Supports no archive promise and device/browser validation.

sources.title: CouchDB performance — deleted documents
sources.version_or_commit: Stable 3.5 docs; no patch commit bound
sources.observed_operation: Opened and read deleted-document retention passage.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Normal deletion creates a new _deleted revision that remains after compaction so deletion can replicate; tombstones consume storage. This does not establish backup/export expiry or physical erasure.
sources.applicability: Supports P13 deletion semantics and separation from retention/erasure policy.
